title: Isolation of human cutaneous immune cells for single-cell RNA sequencing
author: Hailer, Wu, et al.
materials: Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3ʹ Reagent Kit v3.1
Phosphate buffered saline without calcium or magnesium
Corning™ 5 mL Falcon™ round-bottom polystyrene test tubes

steps.title: Prepare reagents and sorter access
steps.instruction: Gather all downstream reagents (Cell Staining Buffer, FACS buffer, CD45‑APC antibody, DAPI stock, Trypan Blue 0.4 %) and confirm that a FACS sorter will be available on day two; keep all reagents on ice or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Store biopsy in cold media
steps.instruction: Place the 6 mm full‑thickness punch biopsy in RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % FBS, 100 IU/mL Penicillin, 100 µg/mL Streptomycin, and 10 mM HEPES; keep the tube at 4 °C in a biosafety cabinet until the late‑afternoon start of the overnight (16–18 h) enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Stain and wash immune cells (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Perform antibody staining, washes, and filtration to generate a single‑cell suspension ready for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well plate at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant by tipping the plate.
Resuspend cells in 100 µL antibody cocktail (97 µL Cell Staining Buffer + 3 µL CD45 Mouse Anti‑Human APC, ~1:30 dilution).
Incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark (antibodies are light‑sensitive).
Add 150 µL FACS buffer, pipette up/down three times (gentle mixing).
Centrifuge 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 200 µL FACS buffer; pipette up/down three times.
Centrifuge 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 µL FACS buffer.
Transfer the suspension to a filtered FACS tube using the same pipette tip.
Wash the original well with an additional 200 µL FACS buffer and pass through the same filter.
Fill a new 5 mL FACS tube with 3 mL Cell Staining Buffer (collection tube for sorted cells).

steps.title: Prepare flow‑cytometry gating
steps.instruction: Set up gating hierarchy and DAPI test on a control skin sample before processing patient biopsies.

substeps.instruction: Create FSC vs SSC gate to capture cells.
Create FSC‑Area vs FSC‑Width gate (or SSC‑A vs SSC‑H) to exclude doublets.
Plot DAPI‑A vs SSC‑A; gate out DAPI‑positive (dead) cells. DAPI stock is 1 µg/mL; plan to add 1 µL per 1 × 10⁶ cells.
Plot SSC‑A vs CD45‑APC; gate CD45⁺ immune cells.
Save the gating layout for later sorting.

steps.title: Sort CD45⁺ cells with flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Isolate live CD45⁺ immune cells using the BD FACSAria Fusion (or equivalent) sorter.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the sorter, calibrate, and set sorting pressure to the lowest setting.
Open the previously saved gating template.
Add DAPI to the cell suspension (final 1 µL per 1 × 10⁶ cells) and flick‑mix.
Incubate 5 min (protected from light).
Begin sorting into the 5 mL collection tube that already contains 3 mL Cell Staining Buffer; expect ~400 µL of suspension to be sorted in ~25 min (≈1.5 h for three samples).

steps.title: Prepare CD45⁺ cells for 10× library
steps.instruction: Wash, count, and adjust cell concentration for Chromium Single‑Cell library construction.

substeps.instruction: Add FACS buffer to the sorting tube to bring the total volume to 5 mL.
Resuspend gently to wash tube walls.
Centrifuge 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C; pour off supernatant.
Centrifuge again at 400 g for 1 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the remaining volume and transfer to a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.
Spin the plate at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 10 µL Cell Staining Buffer to reach ~41 µL total volume (allows loading of up to 5 µL on the Chromium chip after a 7.5 µL loss for counting).
Transfer the cell suspension to a low‑retention 0.8 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Perform a viability count: mix 7.5 µL cells with 7.5 µL 0.4 % Trypan Blue, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then load 10 µL onto a hemocytometer.
Record total cell yield (healthy skin ≈5,000–20,000 cells; inflamed skin ≈5,000–50,000 cells, average ≈30,000).
Adjust concentration to 700–1,200 cells/µL with Cell Staining Buffer if outside this range; repeat count if adjusted.
Proceed to the 10× Genomics Chromium Single‑Cell 3′ (v3.1) or 5′ (v2) library preparation according to the manufacturer’s protocol (typically 20,000 read pairs per cell).
